target_journal.title: International Journal of Hydrogen Energy
target_journal.scope_basis: The publisher describes original analytical and experimental research across hydrogen production, storage, transmission, utilization and enabling technologies; a safety digital twin for hydrogen refuelling is within that scope.

research_data_policy.observed_policy: Elsevier describes repository deposit, dataset citation/linking and a Research Data Availability Statement as journal-dependent options; the target journal's Guide for Authors must control the final submission choice.
project_implications: Freeze raw-data provenance, hashes, preprocessing and reuse rights before manuscript submission.
Deposit reusable data and code where permission allows, or provide a precise access restriction statement.
Do not describe simulated, digitized or aggregate records as synchronized station logger data.

claim_boundary: This record establishes journal-scope and publisher-policy context only. It does not establish external validation, scientific validity, safety certification, editorial acceptance or goal completion. Journal-specific instructions must be checked again at submission time.
